docs.summary:
Describes a contact between one of this GameObject's colliders and something else. Both sides of a contact receive their own copy, each describing the other side.

Static geometry has no rigidbody of its own, so [`Rigidbody`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Collision~Rigidbody) is null for it and [`Collider`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Collider) is what names the surface. Terrain has neither, and only fills in [`GameObject`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.GameObject).
The rigidbody that was hit. Null for static geometry and terrain.
The collider that was hit. Null for terrain.
The collider on this side of the contact. Null for terrain.
The GameObject that was hit: the rigidbody's when there is one, otherwise the collider's or terrain's.
Average contact point in world space, weighted by impulse. Zero on [`OnCollisionEnd`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Component~OnCollisionEnd).
Contact normal in world space, pointing from the other side toward this one. Zero on [`OnCollisionEnd`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Component~OnCollisionEnd).

Total normal impulse the solver applied across the contact in the last substep, which lasts [`FixedDeltaTime`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Time~FixedDeltaTime) divided by [`Substep`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.PhysicsWorld~Substep). Zero on [`OnCollisionEnd`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Component~OnCollisionEnd).
The Transform of whatever was hit, or null when nothing identifiable was involved.
